mock_data.title: Goodbye and Hello
mock_data.passage:
I have called you together today for two reasons: one sad and one happy. The sad reason is that Jack Jones, our marketing director, is off to pastures new and we are here to say goodbye and to wish him well. The happy reason is that we are here to welcome Jim White, who is taking over Jack's position in the company.

I know that each and every one of you will be aware of how much work Jack has put into the development of this company. He joined us when we were still a very young company and his efforts have helped us to become the profitable, successful company which we are today. In addition, I am aware that most of you have found him a pleasure to work with. It is rare for someone not to get along with Jack. Of course, the board of directors and I are sorry that he is going, but we quite appreciate that, after all these years, Jack wanted a change of scene.

There was a time, not so long ago, when people stayed with the same company from the cradle to the grave, but things have changed. People now move on. In Jack's case, he is moving on to a much larger company which is very much at the cutting edge of the business. They were impressed with Jack's talents and made him an offer which he could not refuse.

People of Jack's skills are few and far between, but we have been very fortunate in securing the services of Jim White, who will, I am sure, prove a worthy successor to Jack. He has certainly been extremely proactive in the company which he has just left and it is obvious that they are sorry to lose him. I am sure that he will soon find his feet here.

Refreshments have been provided, in the form of wine and canapés, and I suspect that some of you can't wait to get started on them. Without more ado then, I shall, on your behalf, say an official goodbye to Jack and an official hello to Jim. Jack, I have pleasure in presenting this carriage clock to you as a token of our appreciation and, of course, it comes with our best wishes for the future. Jim, I have equal pleasure in saying to you, 'Welcome aboard!'
mock_data.passageB1:
We are here today for two reasons. One is sad, and one is happy. The sad reason is that Jack Jones, our marketing director, is leaving. He is going to work somewhere else. We want to say goodbye to him and wish him good luck. The happy reason is that we want to say hello to Jim White. He is taking over Jack's job in the company.

I know you all know how much Jack has done for this company. He started working here when we were a very small company. He helped us to become successful and make money. Also, I think most of you liked working with him. It was easy to get along with Jack. The directors and I are sad that he is leaving. But we understand that after so many years, Jack wanted a change of scene.

A long time ago, people stayed with one company their whole life. But things are different now. People move on to new jobs. Jack is going to a much bigger company. This company is very modern and doing new things in business. They were impressed by Jack's skills and offered him a job that he could not refuse.

It is hard to find people with Jack's skills. But we are lucky to have Jim White. I am sure he will do a good job in place of Jack. He did a lot of good things at his last company. They are sad that he left. I am sure he will settle in quickly here.

We have some food and drinks for you, like wine and small sandwiches. I think some of you are looking forward to eating them! So, I will now say goodbye to Jack and hello to Jim for all of us. Jack, we want to give you this clock as a gift to show that we are thankful for your work. We wish you all the best for the future. Jim, welcome to the team! We are happy to have you on board.
mock_data.passageB2:
We've gathered here today for a bittersweet occasion: to say goodbye to Jack Jones, our departing Marketing Director, and to welcome Jim White, his esteemed replacement.

I'm sure you all recognise Jack's significant contribution to the company's growth. He joined us in our early days, and his hard work has been instrumental in making us the successful and profitable organisation we are today. Moreover, I know many of you have enjoyed working with him. He has a real knack for getting along with people. While the board and I are sad to see him go, we understand his desire for a fresh start after all these years.

It wasn't that long ago that people stayed with one company for their entire career. But times have changed, and people now seek new opportunities. Jack is moving to a much larger company, a real trailblazer in its field. They were clearly impressed by his abilities and made him an offer he simply couldn't refuse. This move is a testament to his skills and experience.

Someone with Jack's talent is hard to find, but we're very lucky to have secured Jim White, who I’m confident will be a worthy successor. He was clearly very proactive in his previous role, and they were clearly sorry to see him leave. I'm sure he'll settle in quickly here. He has already demonstrated a keen interest in our work.

We have refreshments available – wine and canapés – and I imagine some of you are eager to get started. So, without further ado, I'd like to formally say goodbye to Jack and welcome Jim. Jack, it's my pleasure to present you with this carriage clock as a token of our gratitude, and with our best wishes for the future. Jim, a very warm welcome on board!
mock_data.passageC1:
Colleagues, we've convened today for a bittersweet occasion, one tinged with both regret and anticipation. Regret, as we bid farewell to Jack Jones, our esteemed Marketing Director, who is embarking on a new chapter. Anticipation, as we simultaneously extend a warm welcome to Jim White, his successor, who will be stepping into some rather large shoes.

It scarcely needs stating that each of you is acutely aware of the instrumental role Jack has played in the company's trajectory. He joined us during our nascent stages, and his unwavering dedication has been indispensable in transforming us into the prosperous and thriving enterprise we are today. Furthermore, I believe I speak for the majority when I say that Jack has been an unfailingly affable colleague. It is a testament to his character that he has forged such positive relationships across the board. While the board and I are, naturally, saddened by his departure, we fully appreciate his desire for a change of scenery after such a considerable tenure.

Gone are the days when employees remained with a single organization for the entirety of their careers; such tenure is increasingly anachronistic. Nowadays, professional mobility is the norm. In Jack's case, he is transitioning to a considerably larger organization, one that is at the forefront of innovation within the sector. They were evidently impressed by Jack's considerable acumen and extended an offer that proved irresistible.

Individuals possessing Jack's calibre are, admittedly, few and far between. However, we are exceedingly fortunate to have secured the services of Jim White, who, I am confident, will prove to be a worthy successor. His proactive approach within his previous company was readily apparent, and it is clear that his former colleagues are loath to see him go. I have no doubt that he will acclimatise swiftly to our environment.

To facilitate the transition and mark this occasion, refreshments, specifically wine and canapés, have been provided, and I suspect many of you are eager to partake. Therefore, without further ado, I shall, on your behalf, formally express our gratitude and farewell to Jack, and simultaneously, extend a formal greeting to Jim. Jack, it is with immense pleasure that I present you with this carriage clock as a token of our appreciation, accompanied by our sincerest best wishes for your future endeavors. Jim, it gives me equal pleasure to say, 'Welcome aboard!' and we anticipate your fresh perspective.

questions.answer: Answers may vary. Examples: Why is Jack leaving? What will the new person be like? How long has Jack worked there? What position is changing? Will there be other changes?
questions.question: Ask a question that you want answered after reading the passage.

questions.answer: The title 'Goodbye and Hello' is unusual because it combines two opposite greetings in one phrase. It suggests both an ending (goodbye) and a beginning (hello) happening simultaneously, which reflects the dual nature of the event - someone leaving and someone new arriving.
questions.question: What is unusual about the title above?

questions.answer: Answers may vary. Typically includes: appreciation for their work/contributions, positive personal qualities, acknowledgment of their achievements, good memories/experiences together, gratitude for their dedication, best wishes for the future, acknowledgment that they'll be missed.
questions.question: What is usually said about a person in a farewell speech to him?

mock_data.translation:
Men sizlarni bugun ikki sabab bilan yig'dim: biri qayg'u, ikkinchisi quvonch. Qayg'uli sabab shuki, Jek Jons, bizning marketing direktori, yangi o'rinlarga ketmoqda va biz bu yerda unga xayrlashish va yaxshilik tilash uchun yig'ildik. Quvonchli sabab esa biz bu yerda Jim Uaytni qutlab olish uchun yig'ilganmiz, u Jekning kompaniyadagi lavozimini egallaydi.

Men bilamanki, har biringiz Jek bu kompaniya rivojiga qancha ko'p mehnat qo'yganini bilasiz. U bizga qo'shilganida biz hali juda yosh kompaniya edik va uning harakatlari bizga bugungi kunda foydali va muvaffaqiyatli kompaniyaga aylanishga yordam berdi. Bundan tashqari, men bilamanki, ko'pchilikingiz u bilan ishlash yoqimli bo'lgan. Jek bilan til topishmaydigan odam topish qiyin. Albatta, direktorlar kengashi va men uning ketishidan afsusdamiz, ammo biz tushunamizki, shuncha yillardan keyin Jek muhit o'zgarishini xohladi.

Yaqinda bo'lmagan bir payt bor edi, odamlar bir kompaniyada beshikdan qabrga qadar qolardilar, ammo vaziyat o'zgardi. Odamlar endi oldinga siljiydilar. Jekning holatida, u ancha katta kompaniyaga o'tmoqda, bu kompaniya biznesning eng ilg'or qirralarida. Ular Jekning iste'dodidan hayratda qoldilar va unga rad eta olmaydigan taklif qildilar.

Jek kabi mahoratga ega odamlar kam va kam uchraydi, ammo biz Jim Uaytning xizmatlarini olishda juda omadli bo'ldik, u, ishonchim komilki, Jekga munosib voris bo'ladi. U hozirgina tark etgan kompaniyada juda faol bo'lgan va ular uni yo'qotishdan afsusdalar. Ishonchim komilki, u bu yerda tez orada o'rganib ketadi.

Sharoblar va kanape ko'rinishida yengil taomlar tayyorlangan va menimcha ba'zilaringiz ularni tatib ko'rishga sabrsizlanayotgan bo'lsangiz kerak. Demak, ortiqcha gaplarsiz, men sizlar nomidan Jekka rasmiy xayrlashaman va Jimga rasmiy salom berishim kerak. Jek, men sizga qadirdonligimizning belgisi sifatida ushbu soatni taqdim etishdan mamnunman va, albatta, u kelajagingiz uchun eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan birga keladi. Jim, sizga "Xush kelibsiz!" deb aytishdan mamnunman.

mock_data.translationB1:
Biz bugun bu yerga ikki sababga ko'ra yig'ildik. Biri qayg'uli, ikkinchisi esa quvonchli. Qayg'uli sabab shuki, bizning marketing bo'yicha direktorimiz Jek Jons ishdan ketyapti. U boshqa joyda ishlaydi. Biz u bilan xayrlashib, unga omad tilaymiz. Quvonchli sabab shuki, biz Jim Uayt bilan salomlashmoqchimiz. U kompaniyada Jekning ishini o'z zimmasiga olyapti.

Bilaman, hammangiz Jekning bu kompaniya uchun qancha ish qilganini bilasizlar. U bu yerda juda kichik kompaniya bo'lganimizda ishlay boshlagan edi. U bizga muvaffaqiyatga erishishga va pul topishga yordam berdi. Shuningdek, o'ylaymanki, ko'pchiligingiz u bilan ishlashni yoqtirgansizlar. Jek bilan kelishish oson edi. Direktorlar va men uning ketayotganidan xafamiz. Ammo shuncha yildan keyin Jek vaziyatni o'zgartirishni xohlaganini tushunamiz.

Qadim zamonlarda odamlar butun umri davomida bitta kompaniyada qolishardi. Ammo hozir vaziyat o'zgargan. Odamlar yangi ishlarga o'tishadi. Jek ancha katta kompaniyaga ketyapti. Bu kompaniya juda zamonaviy va biznesda yangi narsalar qilmoqda. Ularga Jekning mahorati yoqdi va unga rad eta olmaydigan ish taklif qilishdi.

Jekning mahoratiga ega bo'lgan odamlarni topish qiyin. Ammo biz Jim Uaytga ega ekanligimizdan omadlimiz. Ishonchim komilki, u Jekning o'rniga yaxshi ishlaydi. U oxirgi kompaniyasida ko'p yaxshi ishlar qildi. Uning ketganidan ular xafa. Ishonchim komilki, u bu yerda tezda o'rnashib oladi.

Sizlar uchun vino va kichik sendvichlar kabi ba'zi ovqat va ichimliklarimiz bor. O'ylaymanki, ba'zilaringiz ularni yeyishni intiqlik bilan kutyapsizlar! Shunday ekan, men hozir hammamiz nomidan Jek bilan xayrlashaman va Jim bilan salomlashaman. Jek, biz sizga ishingiz uchun minnatdorchiligimizni bildirish uchun sovg'a sifatida ushbu soatni bermoqchimiz. Kelajakda sizga eng yaxshi tilaklarni tilaymiz. Jim, jamoaga xush kelibsiz! Sizning biz bilan ekanligingizdan xursandmiz.
mock_data.translationB2:
Biz bugun shu yerga achchiq-shirin bir voqea munosabati bilan yig'ildik: bizning ketayotgan Marketing Direktori Jek Jons bilan xayrlashish va uning hurmatli o'rniga kelgan Jim Uaytni kutib olish uchun.

Ishonchim komilki, barchangiz Jekning kompaniyamiz o'sishiga qo'shgan sezilarli hissasini tan olasiz. U bizga dastlabki kunlarimizda qo'shilgan edi va uning qattiq mehnati bizni bugungi muvaffaqiyatli va foydali tashkilotga aylantirishda muhim rol o'ynadi. Bundan tashqari, bilaman, ko'pchiligingiz u bilan ishlashdan zavqlangansiz. Uning odamlar bilan kelishish qobiliyati bor. Boshqaruv kengashi va men uni ketayotganini ko'rishdan xafa bo'lsak-da, ko'p yillardan keyin yangi hayot boshlash istagini tushunamiz.

Odamlar butun faoliyati davomida bir kompaniyada qolgan kunlar unchalik uzoq emas edi. Ammo zamon o'zgardi va odamlar endi yangi imkoniyatlar izlashadi. Jek ancha katta kompaniyaga, o'z sohasida haqiqiy kashshofga o'tmoqda. Ular uning qobiliyatidan juda ta'sirlanishdi va u rad eta olmaydigan taklif qilishdi. Bu qadam uning mahorati va tajribasidan dalolat beradi.

Jekning iste'dodiga ega bo'lgan odamni topish qiyin, ammo biz Jim Uaytni qo'lga kiritganimizdan juda xursandmiz, ishonamanki, u munosib voris bo'ladi. U o'zining oldingi rolida juda faol bo'lgan va ular uni ketayotganini ko'rishdan afsusda bo'lishgan. Ishonchim komilki, u bu yerda tezda o'rnashib oladi. U allaqachon ishimizga qiziqish bildirgan.

Bizda ichimliklar - vino va kanapelar mavjud - va menimcha, ba'zilaringiz boshlashni intiqlik bilan kutmoqdasizlar. Shunday ekan, ortiqcha gapirmasdan, Jek bilan rasmiy xayrlashmoqchiman va Jimni kutib olmoqchiman. Jek, sizga ushbu soatni minnatdorchiligimiz belgisi sifatida taqdim etishdan mamnunman va kelajakda sizga omad tilayman. Jim, xush kelibsiz!
mock_data.translationC1:
Hurmatli hamkasblar, bugun biz achchiq va shirin voqea uchun yig'ildik, ham afsus, ham umid bilan yo'g'rilgan. Afsus, biz yangi sahifa ochayotgan hurmatli Marketing Direktorimiz Jek Jons bilan vidolashar ekanmiz. Umid, biz bir vaqtning o'zida uning vorisi Jim Uaytni samimiy kutib olar ekanmiz, u ancha katta o'ringa qadam qo'yadi.

Sizlarning har biringiz Jekning kompaniya rivojida muhim rol o'ynaganidan yaxshi xabardorsizlar. U bizga endigina shakllanayotgan paytimizda qo'shildi va uning sadoqati bizni bugungi gullab-yashnagan korxonaga aylantirishda ajralmas bo'ldi. Bundan tashqari, ishonamanki, men ko'pchilikning nomidan gapirib, Jek doimo xushmuomala hamkasb bo'lganini aytishim mumkin. Uning xarakterining dalili shundaki, u hamma bilan ijobiy munosabatlar o'rnata olgan. Boshqaruv kengashi va men, albatta, uning ketishidan afsusdamiz, lekin uzoq muddatdan keyin atrof-muhitni o'zgartirish istagini to'liq tushunamiz.

Xodimlar butun faoliyati davomida bitta tashkilotda qolgan kunlar o'tib ketdi; bunday ish staji tobora eskirgan bo'lib qolmoqda. Hozirgi kunda professional harakatchanlik me'yorga aylangan. Jekning holatida u ancha katta tashkilotga o'tmoqda, bu tashkilot sohada innovatsiyalar yetakchisi hisoblanadi. Ular Jekning katta aql-zakovatidan ta'sirlanishdi va rad etib bo'lmaydigan taklifni berishdi.

Jekning darajasiga ega bo'lgan shaxslar, to'g'risini aytsam, juda kam. Ammo biz Jim Uaytning xizmatlarini qo'lga kiritganimizdan juda xursandmiz, u, ishonchim komilki, munosib voris bo'ladi. Uning oldingi kompaniyasidagi faol yondashuvi yaqqol ko'rinib turardi va uning sobiq hamkasblari uni ketishni xohlamasligi aniq. Shubhasizki, u bizning muhitimizga tezda moslashadi.

O'tishni osonlashtirish va ushbu voqeani nishonlash uchun ichimliklar, xususan, vino va kanapelar taqdim etildi va menimcha, ko'pchiligingiz ularni tatib ko'rishga shoshyapsizlar. Shuning uchun, ortiqcha gapirmasdan, men sizning nomingizdan Jekga minnatdorchiligimizni va xayrlashuvimizni rasman bildiraman va bir vaqtning o'zida Jimga rasmiy tabrik yo'llayman. Jek, sizga minnatdorchiligimiz belgisi sifatida ushbu soatni taqdim etishdan juda xursandman, kelgusi ishlaringizga chin dildan tilaklarimizni bildiramiz. Jim, aytishdan xursandman: "Xush kelibsiz!" va biz sizning yangi qarashingizni kutamiz.
